name: Clarington Connector
monitor_reason: No concrete step: no filing, permit, route, length or final investment decision found. EQT only reports the line in its 2026 growth budget and earnings calls.
researcher_notes: EQT upsized this planned Pennsylvania to Ohio line from 300 to 400 million cubic feet a day on its fourth quarter 2025 earnings call. A February 2026 RBN Energy article says it would carry gas into Ohio to use the price gap between two hubs, with planned Ohio data center demand as an added reason, and that it should be in service by the end of 2026. EIA's August 2026 release (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 26) lists it as Announced, intrastate, 2028, 400 MMcf/d, length blank, state regulator Ohio PUC, and says it serves data center and power demand. A February 2026 Pipeline and Gas Journal article lists the line inside EQT's 580 to 640 million dollar growth budget. No length, route, permit filing, or investment decision was found, so it is held as a watch item. No row exists in the tracker and it is not the Borealis line. The data center link is stated by press and EIA but names no campus or customer, so DataCenter would be yes only if a person accepts that wording. Dates conflict: EQT says end of 2026, EIA says 2028. The related EQT Oakgate pipeline (200 MMcf/d) is named only in the EIA note. Searches found no other source naming it, so it is not staged. Add this as a new row once a filing, route or length appears.
